description: Discovers terraform infrastructure repositories within the workleap organisation that contains a Renovate configuration file, and execute Renovate by using each individual repository configuration

packageRules.description: FENG-2646: migrate Azure/naming to the Workleap fork, which drops two billable random_string resources per module instance. Scoped to 0.4.2/0.4.3 because the fork is cut from 0.4.3: lower pins (0.2.0/0.3.0/0.4.0 in wl-terraform-wlplatform) cross upstream naming changes that would rename live Azure resources, and the `~> 0.4` ranges in wl-terraform-ittech would be rewritten to `~> 1.0` rather than pinned. Those six blocks are handled by hand. Remove this rule once the estate is migrated.
